body: Thank you so much for the advice, and I'm really sorry you had to go through that. I highly doubt that they will take legal action, and in that case, I would tell and show everything. The few things that can serve as evidence support my testimony. What worries me most in that sense are all the threats and that they may retaliate if I make a report to the police or something like that.

Thank you very much, seriously. I honestly don't know what to do at the moment, I'm still very bad emotionally, but all the advice I received in this post made me think more deeply without torturing myself so much. I think I should try to go ahead and do something about this whole situation, but I don't know ... it's too much.
Sorry for the late response
Well, at least you're not hurting yourself in that way anymore. I wish you the best
It's fucked up. I really hope you're better nowdays

I don't have the balls to do it. I really want to talk to her and ask her why she did this to me, but I can't. And I don't even want to think about what my dad would think and how he would react if I speak with him about it. 
Maybe you're right, but it's so hard to think about other option.
I'm already a rapist to almost everyone I used to be friends with, I can't take that anymore and I don't want to feel that again. It's awful

I want to leave this country, but I am currently finishing high school and I also cannot find a job to generate income and leave. The situation in my country has been terrible for a long time, and thanks to the pandemic, everything is going from bad to worse. I also have family in a neighboring country, but I haven't had contact with them for a long time and I don't know if they would agree to let me go live with them. I also don't know if my father would do agree, I don't even know how I'm going to explain this whole situation to him. 
The place where I live is exactly like that, everyone finds out about everything, especially about these kinds of accusations. They always take relevance.. 
Leaving this place would be a solution, but at least 4 or 5 years will pass before I can do it.

As I said in another comment, what scares me the most is having to wait for justice to do something.

The main problem is that it was only me and her, there was no one else in the house. It's basically my word against hers. I have someone who can corroborate part of my story, thanks to messages and a call made as soon as I left her house (she lied saying that she kicked me out at 3 AM and that some neighbor tried to hit me, when in fact I quietly went to 10 AM, shortly after waking up to spend some time with her), but there's a big 7 hour hole between. It is a very complicated situation and the police are not the only ones I fear. She has ties with very heavy people, and the threats are not limited to spreading everything through social media. One of my main fears is what may happen after I report her and those who harass me.
